newsitem.title: UK: ICl shares fall after UBS cuts forecasts.
newsitem.headline: ICl shares fall after UBS cuts forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc fell on Friday after analysts at UBS cut their profit estimates for the company, dealers said.
By 1007 GMT, ICI shares were six pence weaker at 736.

UBS analyst Alasdair Nisbet said he had maintained his "hold" recommendation but cut his forecasts for 1996 pre-tax profits to 610 million stg from 650 million, 1997 profits to 680 million from 800 million and 1998 profits to 750 million from 850 million.
Nisbet said he expected pre-tax profits of 550 million pounds in 1999 and 400 million in the year 2000.
A strong sterling was one of the factors behind the earnings downgrades, Nisbet said. "There will be a hit on profits of around 120 million pounds from the currency in 1997," he said.

"Prices will be up a bit and volumes will be up a bit but the real message is that I don't think ICI will get back to the level of their peak 1995 profits of 951 million pounds before economic activity and overcapacity push margins down again," he said. "Prices will begin to come under pressure in 1998."
